title: Smooth and unique jet and germ parallel transport for singularly foliated bundles with a complete smooth partial connection and enough conservation laws
author: Lachlan Ewen MacDonald
work: The Holonomy Groupoids of Singularly Foliated Bundles
source_version: Official SIGMA 17 (2021) article 043, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2021.043; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256
difficulty_reason: The author constructs parallel transport on diffeological pseudo-bundles of invariant jets and germs, where ordinary manifold flow theory alone does not establish germ-level uniqueness. The proof uses a germ tangent-space description, bracket-preserving flow conjugation, parameter-dependent domain control and explicit plot smoothness. These obligations go beyond the regular-foliation or finite-dimensional connection argument.

source_check.note: Read Theorem 4.10 and its complete proof, Lemma 4.11 parameter-domain control, Proposition 3.9 germ tangent-space calculation, and the singular partial connection/conservation law/path diffeology definitions. The proof explicitly separates finite jets, inverse-limit jets and germs and gives the local representative and plot calculations. Standard parameter-dependent manifold flow existence and invariance of a singular foliation under its own flows are identified prior results. Neither the later hierarchy theorem with proof referred to a prior paper nor the holonomy quotient comparison is selected. Source approval supplied only by exact frozen root input; no new source/difficulty decision or mathematical referee.
